pages.text: Repeat the child action a set number of times. An optional index variable starts at zero.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Add the body costs for every actual repetition. Loops do not discount damage or materials.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.2 + L(n)*C, for maximum repetitions n and body complexity C.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
